test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'A x B' means ‘A is the son of B’,

'A – B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,

'A + B' means ‘A is the wife of B’,

'A % B' means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is M related to T if ‘M x N + P % S – T’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png]

Given: M x N + P % S – T

M x N → M is the son of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c957344dfb5c98aceeca3da89d4a9aa03d9df49ead5067c443485c078d35b315.png] 

N + P → N is the wife of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/835dc214e5e625dd8165ca327c314fc780775e43f9280e520755e50a4e106232.png] 

P % S → P is the father of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a57e999e67533dc88548a1ea19fc24db6dc38ef3d4311facbb608a5635e4641f.png] 

S – T → S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4a7979142670ece5191cb8538584c57a54fa73e24a70e260744f914f7879fca.png] 

So, M is the brother of T.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
